technical.summary: SNPS shows established uptrend structure with price above key moving averages, but overbought momentum indicators (RSI 71.5, Stoch 87.8) and stochastic bearish cross signal caution; moderate confluence with neutral sector backdrop limits swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 16 days create a low-conviction setup with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals with junior congressional activity (small amounts, alternating buy/sell), neutral market sentiment (AAII bearish-leaning, Fear/Greed at 60), and no recent news data to confirm directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (185.3) indicates extreme market stress, FOMC event in 2 days adds binary risk, and earnings in 16 days create additional volatility; falling DXY provides minor relief for tech multinationals but insufficient to offset systemic risks.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above SMA 200 with EMA 50/200 bullish cross and supertrend confirmation establishes structural uptrend, offering swing entry near support at 353.56 with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought momentum (RSI 71.5, Stoch 87.8), stochastic bearish cross, imminent FOMC event (2 days), earnings risk (16 days), VIX crisis levels (185.3), inverted yield curve, and zero fundamental conviction create compounding event risk that overwhelms technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows price at support with established uptrend structure (SMA 200, EMA 50/200 bullish), but overbought momentum indicators and stochastic bearish cross signal imminent pullback risk.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis levels (185.3), inverted yield curve, FOMC event in 2 days, and earnings in 16 days create compounding macro and event risks that overwhelm technical confluence; overbought conditions (RSI 71.5, Stoch 87.8) increase probability of mean reversion into volatility spike.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding SNPS with 37 existing IT positions (6.5% sector concentration); adding here increases concentration risk during macro crisis and earnings blackout period.
